description: Source code for the STMicroelectronics IIS3DHHC accelerometer driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and configuration functions.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches raw acceleration data from the sensor and converts it to CPU endianness.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_convert
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to m/s^2 as sensor_value.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_channel_get_acc
methods.description: Retrieves acceleration data for specific axes.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_channel_get
methods.description: Gets acceleration data for specified channel.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_odr_set
methods.description: Sets the output data rate of the sensor.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes like sampling frequency.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, verifies ID, resets, and configures default settings.

methods.name: iis3dhhc_init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, checks SPI readiness, and calls chip init.
